effect.frozen_path_guard: With gate.state = OPEN, scripts/ci/gate01_frozen_path_guard.py passes every change to a frozen path without a per-PR authorization.

every other CI gate, test, ratchet and the platform route budget

known_open_risks_at_opening: Field kill-switch bypass found by an independent review on 2026-11-12: an OPEN command whose decision and command carry no field id is published to a valve on a halted field (actuator_runtime.py, decision-service persistence.py). Same on main. Fix in progress on branch fix/decision-engines-dispatch-soil-trace.
decision-service authenticates every caller with one shared bearer token, and reviewer and authorizer identities are caller-supplied headers.
Owner ruling pending on #1386: whether CLOSE/OFF is published to a halted field.
how_to_close: Open a PR that sets gate.state back to CLOSED in docs/architecture/gate01_policy.json. Tightening needs no signature. Re-opening later needs a new signed state_transition with a new decision id.
